name: Example: Sketching a Function Given the Graph of its Derivative and a Point on the Graph
problem:
The graph of $y=f'(x),$ the derivative of $f(x),$ is shown below. Given that $f(0)=0,$ sketch a possible graph of $y=f(x).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/ef91945c0b2261785677c4c8ba7e6d202f62bc6c2da20a213bcba03cbcad8556.png)
worked_solution:
Recall that critical points of $y=f(x)$ occur when $f'(x)=0$ or $f'(x)$ does not exist. In our case, there is one critical point:

$$
x=-2
$$

Also, we have the following: 

- If $f'(x) > 0$ then $f(x)$ is increasing.

- If $f'(x) <          0$ then $f(x)$ is decreasing.

We can now summarize the information from the graph in the table below.

| $x$ | $(-\infty,-2)$ | $-2$ | $(-2,\infty)$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f'$ | $-$ | $0$ | $+$ |
| $f$ | $\searrow$ | $\textrm{min}$ | $\nearrow$ |

Let's now sketch the graph of $y=f(x)\mathbin{:}$

- First, we draw the critical point. Consider the vertical line $x=-2.$

- Since we are told that $f(0)=0,$ we can draw that point on the graph.

- Since $f(x)$ is increasing $\nearrow$ on $(-2,\infty),$ the point at $x=-2$ must be lower than the point at $x=0.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/4b599481e7a73ec38b6f0f627b1b9a551c65e6cd3875b3789f0e7ebfa03eb786.png)

- Next, we consider the behavior of $y=f(x)$ in the neighborhood of the critical point:

- Since $f(x)$ is decreasing $\searrow$ on $(-\infty,-2)$ and increasing $\nearrow$ on $(-2,\infty)$, the graph of $y=f(x)$ goes up to the left and to the right of $x=-2.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/1ae0017fd07d6e9fa04f233ca31ab89a07260a5dbc5557e4c8ae35ff91d61f43.png)

- Finally, by connecting and extending the existing parts with a smooth curve, we obtain a possible graph of $y=f(x)\mathbin{:}$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14200695/assets/c215907aa0cc156e92ab3b6710d844e774df3149656fc2f71f27ee01db87382e.png)
